Branch (a), which I expect: the 23 index rows are the only heading candidates in the document, they match the canonical titles well, so the pipeline resolves every item to a short index row at the very end of the file — the intc-2002 stub collapse of ADR-015 repeated exactly as that ADR predicted it would be, with each item scoring BASE_STRICT 0.95 because the heading text matched, and the total extracted length (the whole index is on the order of 2,000 chars) sitting above NO_EMPTY_SUCCESS_FLOOR = 1,000, so `no_empty_success` does NOT catch it and doc_status is likely `success_with_warning`. The min_chars floors are the checks that should go red. I expect branch (a) because the demo's own symptom, and interviewer 1's independent report (postmortem §8), was 'only short cross-reference/index fragments captured'. Branch (b): ADR-015's `_toc_runs` logic treats the trailing index as a table of contents and drops all 23 candidates, in which case every item comes back `missing` at 0.40 and the item_present checks go red instead. Either branch is a failure of this case and both are honest failure modes worth recording.

triage.note: Triaged 2026-08-27 under `failure-triage`, as the burn rule's first step requires. The exam ran `intc-2025` live with `escalate=True` and the deterministic half behaved exactly as D8/D11 designed: coverage 0.0033, doc_status `ambiguous`, items 1/7/8 flagged, trigger fired. What failed was the CLIENT: rung 2 (`anthropic/claude-opus-5`) returned `output_tokens: 2048` — exactly the `max_tokens` sent — with empty content, and that empty string reached `json.loads` as an unexplained JSONDecodeError. Classified `input-variant`, not `flake` and not `eval-bug`: an empty completion from a reasoning model whose allowance was consumed before any content was emitted is a legitimate response shape the client did not handle, it reproduces deterministically from the cached response for $0, and no eval was at fault because no eval reached that path. Minimal repro is the cached payload, not this filing — so per the skill's step 1 the ADVERSARIAL case for the defect is `escalation-empty-completion.json`, and this case carries the document. Filed to the `debt` suite, the `axp-2008-combined-part-iii` and `cvx-2015-internal-pointer` precedent: it RUNS every run and is PRINTED, and it is excluded from the score because scoring it would force the choice between breaking the gate and rewriting the labels to assert the bug as correct. It is red because the pipeline still cannot extract this filing — which is the finding, not a defect in the case. If it ever goes green the runner says so, and that is the signal that D11's slow path finally reached the document it was built for.
